blocks.title: Erotic / Sexual Tension Progression
blocks.body: Sunday morning Chotu interrupts Dhika's shower, prompting a rushed towel-covered greeting that she ends by changing before conversation (P1). Both later discuss the earlier E09 kiss, Chotu's embarrassment, and a renewed practical painting plan (P2–P3). During painting, Chotu looks at Dhika's legs; she notices, but neither look constitutes permission for physical contact. In the cramped kitchen, Chotu inadvertently strikes Dhika while straightening: source mechanics show an accident and real pain, followed by apology. After lunch, Dhika specifically offers consensual kissing practice; P6 records two reciprocal kisses. Sunday night a separate public couple/social route begins as Sharmi surprise-hugs John at the cinema (P7).

blocks.title: Reader-Known Secrets & Dramatic Irony
blocks.body: Chotu initially assumes his E09 kiss was inferior; Dhika had thought he might be frightened by her response. Dialogue corrects those misconceptions P2. Dhika internally worries about Chotu not having money or companions to go to a cinema, which prompts her future invitation; it has not happened. The kitchen collision initially makes Dhika angry, but source later confirms she rethinks who was at fault. John is absent from Sunday daylight Chotu events. At the cinema, Sharmi asserts Raj enjoys contrasting sarees; Raj does not yet appear to confirm this by E10 L133. Reader recognizes Dhika is wearing just such a saree before she looks down.

blocks.title: Major Turning Points & Why They Matter
blocks.body: P1 Chotu voluntarily returns to help paint, despite Sunday leave. P2 their prior kiss becomes a direct spoken topic and Chotu names insecurity rather than hurt. P3 Dhika promises a future movie once painting ends and determines stool safety. P4 an avoidable but unintentional kitchen collision disrupts warmth with immediate pain. P5 Dhika reassesses accidental fault and reopens conversation. P6 she introduces a specific present-time offer and a reciprocal two-kiss exchange; this must never erase E06 stop history. P7 returns to public marriage/friendship at the planned horror-film meet-up, closing at a saree-based joke.

blocks.title: Open Hooks / Unresolved Questions
blocks.body: Room still requires further paint and patterns; a future movie with Chotu is promised conditional on completing the room. Sunday horror outing has reached the cinema foyer but movie viewing has not started by L133. Raj's actual response to Sharmi's claimed contrasting-saree preference is not shown; no new Raj interaction may be imported from E11. Whether and how E06 boundary damage is explicitly discussed further remains unresolved despite E09/E10 reassurance. Swiss mentor contest is a separate prior-series open hook.

blocks.title: Reader Possibilities — NON-CANON
blocks.body: Future room completion and Chotu–Dhika cinema trip are offered but unscheduled. Raj's possible reaction to Dhika's contrasting saree could generate another public social conversation, but no E10 facts establish what that reaction is. Future continuation of the current voluntarily initiated kissing practice is not authorized by this episode alone. Any future revelation to John or change in marriage must be sourced later rather than inferred from the present private-daylight scene.

blocks.title: Episode-End Reader Carry-Forward
blocks.body: E10 L133 is the hard stop: Dhika, John and Sharmi are at the cinema entrance; Sharmi has greeted John with a surprise hug, John has looked at her attire, and both tease Dhika by pointing out Raj's alleged contrasting-saree preference exactly matches her outfit. Raj is expected in group plan but not directly shown speaking or arriving. Earlier Sunday Chotu painting/lunch/kiss encounter has ended; John has no verified knowledge of it. Movie has not started.
